text:
Munster’s median asking rent stands at 13.92 €/m², up 5.4 % year‑on‑year and 30.9 % over the last five years, placing the city 11th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 60 m² benchmark rent is 835 € per month, while the asking premium over existing rents is 60 %, reflecting strong upward momentum.

The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.1 % and properties staying on the market for an average of 21 days; 36 % are let within a week. Affordability is moderate, as the rent‑burden for two residents is 17.2 % and the median asking rent sits between the 25th percentile of 11.82 €/m² and the 75th percentile of 16.22 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 14.54 €/m² in 12 months, ranging from 14.03 €/m² to 14.93 €/m², implying a further 4.5 % rise.
